    Bug 2062563 - Port bug 2033838: Specify hg when cloning, for comm tasks. r=tobyp DONTBUILD
    
    Port of https://hg-edge.mozilla.org/mozilla-central/rev/6b0f347cc782e6298dbe38d75fa313bbcca4a528,
    basically adding "clone-with: hg" wherever "comm-checkout: true" exists in the "run" section of a
    task specification.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D317752

diff --git a/taskcluster/comm_taskgraph/transforms/job/toolchain.py b/taskcluster/comm_taskgraph/transforms/job/toolchain.py
index c0d2b70d8c2..498428215a1 100644
--- a/taskcluster/comm_taskgraph/transforms/job/toolchain.py
+++ b/taskcluster/comm_taskgraph/transforms/job/toolchain.py
@@ -99,6 +99,7 @@ def get_digest_data(config, run, taskdesc):
 def docker_worker_toolchain(config, job, taskdesc):
     run = job["run"]
     run["comm-checkout"] = True
+    run["clone-with"] = "hg"
 
     worker = taskdesc["worker"] = job["worker"]
     worker["chain-of-trust"] = True
